base: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone PNG game asset, never a sheet or collage. Match the supplied world reference exactly in rendering and design: warm softly painted polished 2.5D school illustration, cream, medium school blue, golden yellow, muted teal, warm maple and orange. Soft upper-left/front daylight, clean silhouettes. Modern present-day school, practical equipment, no futuristic elements, holograms, neon or sci-fi. No words, letters, logos, watermark.
